description: A utility module for currency conversions and formatting, including USD to credits conversion, parsing USD strings, and rendering formatted currency with credits.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on a shared rate, rounding to the nearest whole credit.

methods.name: parseUsdToNumber
methods.description: Parses a USD-like string or number into a numeric value, handling currency symbols and commas.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a number of credits with thousands separators and appends 'credits'.

methods.name: formatUSD
methods.description: Formats a number or string as USD currency using a shared formatter, with fallback to an em dash.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Formats USD with credits in parentheses, including support for credits display.

methods.name: renderUsdWithCredits
methods.description: Renders USD amount with credits in a span, showing USD first and credits in parentheses.
